Require x >= 0. The two cases give x = -3 and x = 1; reject -3 because its right side is negative.
Between -2 and 4 the sum is 6. To the left it is 2 - 2x = 8, giving -3. To the right it is 2x - 2 = 8, giving 5.
For 2 <= x <= 6 the left side is 4, so |2x - 8| = 1, giving 7/2 and 9/2. Outside this interval the right side exceeds the left by 3.
